description:
0.11.0 fixed silent binding to the wrong tracker: the "Bound store" section and `get_instructions(expect_store=...)`. The maintainer's machine still runs the old runtime and the old skill text, so the fix is inactive outside BenchBox.

- Runtime: `uv tool list` reports todo-db v0.10.1 (the CLI has no `--version` flag). The uv tool receipt (`~/.local/share/uv/tools/todo-db/uv-receipt.toml`) installed it from `directory = /Users/joe/Developer/todo-db`, which copies the tree at install time, so merges and tags never update it. Clients that launch `todo-db-mcp` from PATH get 0.10.1: this repository's `.mcp.json` (no arguments) and `~/.gemini/settings.json`. Codex runs `uv run --project ~/Developer/todo-db --locked -- todo-db-mcp` and follows the primary clone instead. On 2026-10-31 a server started from this repository answered `get_instructions(expect_store="joeharris76/todo-db")` with no "Bound store" section, which is the 0.10.1 behaviour: `expect_store` is ignored.
- Skill: the global copies (`~/.claude/skills/todo`, `~/.agents/skills/todo`, `~/.codex/skills/todo`) never mention `expect_store`. All three loader directories are symlinks to `~/.skill-sync-deployment/releases/cb442602…/store/skills`. The deployment config `~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf` (a copy of the template `deployment/global/skill-sync.conf` in skill-sync-skills, not a Git repository) pins the catalog group at `48be048`, before skill-sync-skills#99 (`c624975`). Shipping it takes four steps: bump `rev` in the template through review, set the same `rev` in the deployment config, `tools/skill-sync apply` and `verify` into `store/skills`, then snapshot the store to `releases/<sha>` and repoint the three symlinks. The skill-sync-skills README requires explicit owner approval for the repointing.
- Bump range: `48be048..c624975` also ships other merged catalog changes to the global store: `benchbox/references/release.md` (#97), `session-takeover`, `shared-change-framework` and `shared-review-protocol` (#86), and `todo` (#99).
- Owner work in progress: the primary skill-sync-skills clone has uncommitted edits to README.md and to the template's comment (adding `~/.agents/skills`). Leave them untouched; change only the `rev` line.
- Process: `docs/operations/release-gates.md` covers the gates before the tag but no rollout step after it.
